instructions: Row 1: four sequential subtle IDLE frames: relaxed standing with friendly expression, natural blink, slight head tilt, settle to neutral. Keep torso nearly fixed. Row 2: four sequential natural WALK cycle frames moving toward viewer right in three-quarter view: left-foot forward contact, passing with right heel lifted, right-foot forward contact, passing with left heel lifted. Arms swing opposite the legs; feet alternate, not four copies of the same step.

Row 1: four sequential SIT DOWN poses, moving from a small knee bend to halfway lowering, then seated upright, then a relaxed seated pose with hands on lap. Sit on an INVISIBLE ordinary stool at normal knee height; do not draw any furniture. Legs together naturally, feet touch the same baseline; seated body is naturally shorter and MUST NOT be enlarged. Row 2: four sequential friendly HELLO WAVE frames: right hand rising to shoulder height, open palm waving outward, waving inward, hand lowering. Ordinary warm greeting, natural fingers, weight steady.

Row 1: four sequential gentle everyday STRETCH frames: shoulders roll back, hands rise just above head with elbows bent, a gentle sideways upper body stretch, arms lower again. Keep feet grounded, clothing unchanged and fully covering as in reference. Row 2: four sequential HAIR TUCK frames: right hand rises toward ear, fingers lightly sweep a lock of hair behind ear, hand rests briefly beside head with a warm smile, hand lowers to neutral. Subtle graceful natural gestures.

Read poses in ROW-MAJOR order, left to right, top to bottom. Frames 1-6: a connected LIGHT POP STEP dance sequence: side step left with bent arms opening, cross-step, right hand to shoulder, side step right, arms return, weight settles; flowing small rhythmic steps. Frames 7-12: a connected ELEGANT WALTZ-INSPIRED SWAY sequence: arms rounded in front, weight left, quarter turn right with one foot pointing, arms softly open, turn front again, settle. Frames 13-16: ENERGETIC DISCO STEP: left arm bent upward and opposite heel lifted, hands near shoulders with a small knee bounce, right arm bent upward and left heel lifted, relaxed open arms. Three distinct upright clothed everyday dance routines. Keep hips neutral, no floor poses or acrobatics. Full-body natural adult anatomy; modest arm spread so hands fit inside each cell.
